title: PPT Constraints
description: Presentation-wide content and visual requirements and prohibitions.

requirements.description: Additional required content, examples, evidence and wording conventions. Do not repeat title, language, count, audience or goal; exclude visual direction, layout and theme settings. Preserve any extra actionable detail when separating mixed requirements. Supplying this list replaces it completely; [] clears it.

prohibitions.description: Explicit content exclusions and prohibitions. Do not restate the basics or positive requirements, and do not store visual or theme settings here. Supplying this list replaces it completely; [] clears it.

items.description: One concrete content requirement or exclusion, according to the containing field; do not put visual settings here.
